findings.description: The new explicit `params` argument is never forwarded to `self.request`, so GET query parameters are silently discarded.
findings.rationale: Calling `session.get(url, params={"q": "test"})` now binds the dictionary to `params` instead of leaving it in `kwargs`. Because the request call omits `params=params`, the server receives no query parameters, potentially returning incorrect results. This also breaks existing keyword-based calls.
